name: Object Editor
description: Table editor for unit, item, ability, buff, doodad, destructable and upgrade data.

mcpTools.name: list_objects
mcpTools.description: Object data of the open map: the objects it adds or changes, or with scope "game" the game's own. Gives ids for get_object.

scope.description: map (default): what the map adds or changes. game: everything in the game.

filter.description: Only ids or names containing this text (not case sensitive). Game names are in the installed language.

mcpTools.name: get_object
mcpTools.description: One object: what the map changes in it, with field names, and with gameValues its values as the game defines them.

id.description: Four letters, like hfoo or h000.

gameValues.description: Also list every field's value from the game (long).

services.description: Object browser over game and custom objects (pick).
